quote: Implicitly nullable parameter types are now deprecated.
reason: Already covered by the existing rule in Parameters.php with a verified fixture; nothing new written.

quote: Passing E_USER_ERROR to trigger_error() is now deprecated.
reason: Reported when the level is written as E_USER_ERROR or 256 in trigger_error()/user_error(); a level from a variable is known at run time only and is not reported. Only a PHP version check marks it guarded; function_exists( "trigger_error" ) does not.

quote: Using "_" as a class name is now deprecated.
reason: Compile-time notice for a class, interface, trait or enum named "_" (class, interface and trait seen on 8.4/8.5 with fixtures that parse on every runtime; the enum is shown by runtime.underscore_enum_name~8.4-dep, which declares it through eval() from 8.1 on because enums do not parse before 8.1).

quote: Raising zero to the power of negative number is deprecated.
reason: Depends on the values of base and exponent; a literal 0 ** -1 is not something plugin code contains. Both ** and pow() raise the deprecation from 8.4 and still return INF.

quote: The E_STRICT constant was deprecated and its corresponding error level was removed.
reason: E_STRICT is in data/catalog/constants.php (deprecated 8.4, verified); the removal of the error level itself has no source form.

quote: The CURLOPT_BINARYTRANSFER constant is deprecated.
reason: CURLOPT_BINARYTRANSFER is in data/catalog/constants.php (deprecated 8.4, verified).

quote: Calling DatePeriod::__construct(string $isostr, int $options = 0) is deprecated.
reason: new DatePeriod() with one or two arguments can only be the ISO string form (the other form needs three), so the argument count decides; parent::__construct( $iso ) in a subclass raises it too but is not reported. new on a subclass of DatePeriod raises it as well (seen on 8.4) and is not reported either: the parent of a class declared in another file is not visible.

quote: Constants SUNFUNCS_RET_TIMESTAMP, SUNFUNCS_RET_STRING, and SUNFUNCS_RET_DOUBLE are now deprecated, following the deprecation of the associated date_sunset() and date_sunrise() functions in PHP 8.1.
reason: SUNFUNCS_RET_TIMESTAMP, SUNFUNCS_RET_STRING and SUNFUNCS_RET_DOUBLE are in data/catalog/constants.php (deprecated 8.4, verified).

quote: Passing null or false to dba_key_split() is deprecated.
reason: The dba extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Deprecated DOM_PHP_ERR constant.
reason: DOM_PHP_ERR is in data/catalog/constants.php (deprecated 8.4, verified).

quote: DOMDocument::$actualEncoding, DOMDocument::config, DOMEntity::$actualEncoding, DOMEntity::$encoding, DOMEntity::$version have been deprecated.
reason: A property read such as $doc->actualEncoding only counts when the object is a DOMDocument or DOMEntity, and the class of a variable is not visible in the source; DOMDocument::$actualEncoding and ::$config shown on the runtimes, the DOMEntity properties were not run.

quote: Deprecated passing incorrect data types for options to ext/hash functions.
reason: Depends on the type of the value inside the $options array at run time (shown with a string seed for murmur3a); the $options parameter itself only exists from 8.1.

quote: Calling intlcal_set() as well as calling IntlCalendar::set() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Calling intlgregcal_create_instance() as well as calling IntlGregorianCalendar::__construct() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Calling ldap_connect() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The ldap extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Calling ldap_exop() with more than 4 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The ldap extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: The mysqli_ping() function and mysqli::ping() method are now deprecated, as the reconnect feature was removed in PHP 8.2.
reason: mysqli_ping() is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.4, verified); the method form $db->ping() is real (runtime fixture) but not reported because the class of the object is not visible in the source.

quote: The mysqli_kill() function and mysqli::kill() method are now deprecated.
reason: mysqli_kill() is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.4, verified); the method form $db->kill() is real (runtime fixture) but not reported because the class of the object is not visible in the source.

quote: The mysqli_refresh() function and mysqli::refresh() method are now deprecated.
reason: mysqli_refresh() and all ten MYSQLI_REFRESH_* constants are in data/catalog/ (deprecated 8.4, verified); the method form $db->refresh() is real (runtime fixture) but not reported because the class of the object is not visible in the source.

quote: Passing explicitly the $mode parameter to mysqli_store_result() has been deprecated.
reason: mysqli_store_result() with two written-out arguments is reported; MYSQLI_STORE_RESULT_COPY_DATA is already in the catalog; the method form $db->store_result( $mode ) is real (runtime fixture) but the class of the object is not visible.

quote: Using escaped question marks (??) inside dollar-quoted strings is deprecated.
reason: The pdo_pgsql extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Calling pg_fetch_result() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The pgsql extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Calling pg_field_prtlen() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The pgsql extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: Calling pg_field_is_null() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: The pgsql extension is in none of the php-wasm runtimes, so nothing about it could be run; no claim enters the product.

quote: lcg_value() is deprecated, as the function is broken in multiple ways.
reason: lcg_value() is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.4, verified).

quote: Calling ReflectionMethod::__construct() with 1 argument is deprecated.
reason: new ReflectionMethod() with exactly one written-out argument is the deprecated "Class::method" form; the argument count decides.

quote: Calling session_set_save_handler() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: session_set_save_handler() with more than two written-out arguments is the callback form; the argument count decides.

quote: Changing the INI settings session.sid_length and session.sid_bits_per_character is deprecated.
reason: Reported for ini_set()/ini_alter()/session_start() options with a literal setting name and a literal value other than the default (32 and 4): the runtimes raise nothing when the default value is set again; php.ini itself is not source code and is out of reach. A sid_length outside 22..256 raises the notice too (plus a warning; seen on 8.4) and is not reported.

quote: Changing the INI settings session.use_only_cookies, session.use_trans_sid, session.trans_sid_tags, session.trans_sid_hosts, and session.referer_check is deprecated.
reason: Literal ini_set()/session_start() values that switch use_only_cookies off, use_trans_sid on, or give trans_sid_tags, trans_sid_hosts or referer_check a non-default value are reported; the SID constant has its own rule constant.session_sid because the generated catalog does not have it. Neither function_exists( "ini_set" ) nor defined( "SID" ) keeps the notices away (fixtures), so only a PHP version check marks these findings guarded. A plugin that defines its own SID constant in another file would be reported wrongly; only a definition in the same file is recognised.

quote: Passing an int to SoapServer::addFunction() is now deprecated.
reason: Depends on the run-time type of the argument and on the object being a SoapServer; the usual spelling, SOAP_FUNCTIONS_ALL, is already reported through the catalog.

quote: The SOAP_FUNCTIONS_ALL constant is now deprecated.
reason: SOAP_FUNCTIONS_ALL is in data/catalog/constants.php (deprecated 8.4, verified).

quote: The SplFixedArray::__wakeup() method has been deprecated as it implements __serialize() and __unserialize() which need to be overwritten instead.
reason: Only a direct call of __wakeup() on an SplFixedArray raises it, and the class of the object is not visible in the source; unserialize() and a subclass calling parent::__wakeup() during unserialize() raised nothing on the runtimes.

quote: Using the default value for $escape parameter of: - SplFileObject::setCsvControl() - SplFileObject::fputcsv() - SplFileObject::fgetcsv() is now deprecated.
reason: Method calls on an object whose class is not visible in the source; $x->fgetcsv() cannot be told from a method of another class.

quote: Calling stream_context_set_option() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
reason: stream_context_set_option() with exactly two written-out arguments is reported; the fallback branch of a function_exists( "stream_context_set_options" ) check is marked as guarded.

quote: Unserializing strings using the uppercase 'S' tag is deprecated.
reason: Depends on the content of the serialized string, which is data and not source code.

quote: Using the default value for $escape parameter of: - fputcsv() - fgetcsv() - str_getcsv() is now deprecated.
reason: fputcsv(), fgetcsv() and str_getcsv() calls that write out fewer arguments than reach $escape, and do not pass it by name, are reported. function_exists( "str_getcsv" ) around the call does not keep the notice away (fixture), so only a PHP version check marks it guarded.

quote: The xml_set_object() function has been deprecated.
reason: xml_set_object() is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.4, verified).

quote: Passing non-callable strings to the xml_set_*_handler() functions is now deprecated.
reason: Detected in part: a literal method-like name given to any of the nine xml_set_*_handler() functions (one fixture each) in a file that mentions xml_set_object and declares no function of that name; handlers from variables, the empty string and classes whose xml_set_object() call is in another file are not reported. The runtime showed a ValueError (not a deprecation) when the names are set before xml_set_object(); the rule cannot see the order reliably and claims only the deprecation.
